title: spec: retire the two inert personal declarations — a view marked personal is visible to everyone, and the docs promise personal views that do not exist
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Filed by the record-page epic seat as an execution step of the ruling on #28971. The maintainer answered 「同意」 (2026-11-02) to the seat's recommendation of option C. Readings are on `main` `ab085a0482`. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## Business reason

An author, usually AI, writes `scope: 'personal'` or `sharing: { type: 'personal' }` on a view. It saves, everyone who can read the object still sees the view, and the toolbar badge says personal. That is a silent promise about who can see the data, and it is false.

Real personal views, ruled on #28971, will be a user-owned data object. They will not use these keys.

## Reading

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:5788`: `ViewScopeSchema` lists `personal`, and its docblock says nothing restricts such an item to one user. It is read at lines 5870 and 6542.
- `view.zod.ts`, `ViewSharingSchema`: `type: z.enum(['personal', 'collaborative']).default('collaborative')`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:6364`: the only reader of `sharing.type`, a read-only badge.
- `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts:13135, 13164`: `scope: 'personal'` appears in conversion material. Read whether these need updating.
- `content/docs/ui/audience-based-interfaces.mdx:51`: "personal views".
- In `examples/` and `skills/`, a search for these two values finds nothing. HotCRM's view files have no `sharing.type` and no `scope: 'personal'`; its two `sharing` blocks are public form links, which this card doesn't touch.

## Target

1. `personal` leaves `ViewScopeSchema`. An authored value is refused with a prescription, not silently accepted, under ADR-0049 and ADR-0087. Use the `spec-property-retirement` skill.
2. `personal` leaves `sharing.type`, the same way. That leaves one value, so read whether `type` and the badge still earn their place, and retire them with it if not. State the reading in the PR.
3. Update the docblocks that call this a parked direction, pointing at #28971.
4. `audience-based-interfaces.mdx:51` says per-user list preferences instead of personal views.

## Not in this card

The personal views themselves and the ADR note. Both are tracked from #28971.

## Acceptance

- Saving a view with either value is refused, and the message says what to do.
- A stored or older artifact follows whatever the retirement route requires, stated in the PR.
- The badge no longer says personal.
- The generated baselines, forms and pins the retirement touches are updated.
- The docs line is corrected.
